name: hermes_trend_index_20261101
comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_TREND_INDEX_20261101 — the Hermes trend index keeps one point per UTC day and parses each snapshot at most once.
Regression for the 2026-11-01 route sweep: GET /api/v2/hermes/outcome-bus/history took 75-95 s because load_outcome_bus_trend
parsed every snapshot on every request (134 outcome files of up to 22 MB = 1.7 GB) and load_universe_trend parsed 1,100 files
(967 MB). Proves newest-snapshot-per-day selection inside the window, the current snapshot winning its day, index reuse with no
re-parse when size/mtime are unchanged, exactly one re-parse when a snapshot changes, out-of-window files never opened, index
pruning, and the undated-filename fallback. Hermetic: temp dirs only, no network, no live DB, no credential. Schedules nothing.
